title: feat(Configure): add configure parameters in search state
body:
This PR add to the search state all configure parameters. That way, if you perform some changes to them when listening to `onSearchStateChange` it will be taken into account. 

I used the `transitionState` function of the connector to be able to add those parameters to the state without the need of calling refine (that triggers a new search). It might not be the most obvious name though.

comments.body: Does transition state means "update the internal state without triggering a new search" (as you said), if so I bet we can find a better name. Any ideas?

Well it's more "modify the search state depending on the previous and next one". 
This function will never be call if no refine are actually perform. So it's not a **standalone** way to update the state without performing the search.
I am fine with the usage of transition state for now, it's there let's use it.
